about: Harley E. Riedel, II is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. He works at Stichter, Riedel, Blain & Postler, P.A., located in Tampa, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Bankruptcy: Business to the surrounding community.
Harley Riedel, II completed legal studies at University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated with the class of 1974. Harley Riedel, II passed the bar in 1974.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
